page.overview:
Who is Albert Einstein?

Albert Einstein was a famous physicist best known for his theory of relativity E = mc². Einstein has become a byword for a person having exceptional intelligence and also used sarcastically to describe someone who is not very intelligent.

School psychologist J. Loren Pryor had a poster of Einstein in his office at Springfield Elementary School. Homer also once had a poster of Albert Einstein in his college dorm bedroom. Sideshow Bob was once going to steal Einstein's DNA from a museum to use to make himself smarter.

When Homer started at college he hung up a poster of Albert Einstein and W. C. Fields in his bedroom.

Einstein has a star on The Jewish Walk of Fame.
